salience.prompt: How much do these topics matter to you when you think about politics?

items.text: Jobs, taxes, housing and the economy
Family, religion and moral questions such as abortion or drugs
Crime, policing, privacy and free speech
Immigration, asylum and national identity
The EU, trade, defence and foreign aid
Climate change, nature and farming
AI, biotech, nuclear power and big tech
How democracy works: trust in politics, referendums, courts, regions
Energy, water and public transport should be owned by the government, not by private companies.
Private companies usually run services like rail and energy more efficiently than the government does.
Basic healthcare should be provided by the state, not by private insurers.

local.NL: Health insurance should be run by one public fund instead of competing private insurers.
local.US: The government should provide health insurance for everyone, replacing private insurance.

items.text: The government should interfere as little as possible in how businesses set their prices.
Rents should be capped by law.

local.NL: The rent rules that now cover mid-range homes should be extended to more of the private rental market.
local.DE: The rent cap (Mietpreisbremse) should be tightened and apply everywhere in Germany.

items.text: Strict rules for businesses cost more jobs than they protect.
Employers should find it harder to fire people.
Companies should be free to hire people on flexible or temporary contracts as much as they like.
The minimum wage should go up substantially, even if some jobs disappear as a result.
People with high incomes should pay a much larger share of their income in tax than they do now.
Benefits should be kept low, so that working always pays clearly more than not working.
I would rather pay less tax than have more public services.
Young children are generally better off when one parent stays at home.
The government should actively work to close the pay gap between men and women.
The government should treat all households the same, whether or not people are married.
Same-sex couples should have exactly the same rights as other couples, including adoption.
Changing your legal gender should require a medical diagnosis, not just a personal declaration.
Schools should leave topics like sexual orientation and gender identity to parents.
Politicians should let religious values guide their decisions.
The state should not fund religious schools.

local.NL: Religious schools should no longer receive the same public funding as public schools.
local.DE: The state should stop collecting church tax on behalf of the churches.
local.US: Public money should never go to religious schools, for example through vouchers.

items.text: The country's Christian roots should be visible in its laws and public life.
Abortion should be legal on request in the first months of pregnancy.
Adults should be able to buy soft drugs such as cannabis legally from regulated shops.

local.NL: Cannabis growing for coffeeshops should be fully legalised and regulated.

items.text: Doctors should never help patients end their life, even when they are suffering unbearably.
Police should be allowed to use facial recognition cameras in public places.
Messaging apps should never be forced to give governments access to encrypted messages.
A national digital ID would give the government too much information about its citizens.

local.UK: A compulsory digital ID for proving the right to work would give the government too much control.

items.text: Sentences for serious crimes should be much longer.
Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
Police should need stronger evidence before they can stop and search someone.
Spreading hateful views about groups of people should be a criminal offence.
People should be free to say offensive things, even if many find them hurtful.
Social media companies should be legally required to remove false information.
In a crisis such as a pandemic, the government should be able to impose restrictions without waiting for parliament.
The right to protest should be protected, even when protests seriously disrupt daily life.
The government should be able to ban groups whose protests it considers extremist.
Immigration to this country should be reduced significantly.
This country needs more immigrants to fill jobs and support an ageing population.
People who have lived here illegally for many years should get a chance to stay legally.
This country should take in fewer asylum seekers, even if that means breaking international agreements.
Refugees fleeing war should be welcomed, even in large numbers.
Asylum claims should be processed outside Europe, in other countries.

local.UK: Asylum seekers who arrive by small boat should be sent to another country to have their claims processed.
local.US: Asylum seekers should wait in other countries while their claims are processed.

items.text: Immigrants should adapt to the customs of this country.
It's good for society when immigrants keep their own culture and traditions.
Judges and police officers should not be allowed to wear religious symbols such as a headscarf at work.
Our national culture is under threat and needs protecting.
I feel more like a citizen of the world than of my own country.
Newcomers should have the same access to social housing as people born here.
The EU should get more power, even if national governments lose some.

local.UK: The UK should rejoin the EU.
local.US: The United States should work more through international organisations such as the UN, even if that limits what it can do alone.

items.text: Decisions should be made nationally as much as possible, not in Brussels.

local.UK: Laws made in Britain should always take priority over international courts and treaties.
local.US: International agreements should never override American law.

items.text: EU membership is good for this country.

local.UK: Britain would be better off back inside the EU's single market.
local.US: International organisations such as the UN and the WTO are good for the United States.

items.text: Tariffs on imports are a good way to protect jobs at home.
More free trade agreements with other countries are good for our economy.

local.NL: The EU trade deal with South American countries (Mercosur) is good for our economy.
local.DE: The EU trade deal with South American countries (Mercosur) is good for our economy.

items.text: Farmers and industry here should be protected against cheaper foreign competition.
We should keep supporting Ukraine militarily for as long as it takes.
NATO membership does this country more harm than good.
Allies should come to each other's defence, even far from home.
Development aid to poorer countries should be cut.
Rich countries have a duty to help poorer countries, even if it costs a lot.
Development aid should only go to countries that take back their own citizens who were refused asylum.
Fighting climate change should come first, even if it slows economic growth.
Climate targets should be delayed if they make life too expensive.
This country should reach net zero emissions well before 2050.
Petrol, diesel and gas should be taxed more heavily to cut emissions.
The sale of new petrol and diesel cars should not be banned.
People should be free to choose between a gas boiler and a heat pump without government rules.

local.DE: The heating law (Gebäudeenergiegesetz) should be scrapped.

items.text: Livestock farming should be reduced to protect nature.

local.NL: The number of livestock should be reduced to bring down nitrogen emissions.

items.text: Building homes and roads should come before protecting nature areas.
More farmland should be turned back into nature.
Rich countries should pay poorer countries to help them cope with climate change.
This country should leave the Paris climate agreement.

local.US: Leaving the Paris climate agreement was the right decision.

items.text: There is little point in cutting our emissions while big countries like China keep polluting.
AI should be developed as fast as possible, with few restrictions.
Development of the most powerful AI systems should be paused until we know they are safe.
Companies should have to protect jobs before replacing workers with AI or robots.
Genetically modified crops should be allowed in our food.
Editing the genes of human embryos should be banned.
Gene editing to prevent serious hereditary diseases should be allowed.
This country should build new nuclear power plants.

local.DE: Germany should bring back nuclear power.

items.text: Nuclear power is too risky to be part of our energy future.
Capturing CO2 and storing it underground is worth investing in.
Big tech companies such as Google, Meta and Amazon should be broken up.
Governments already regulate tech companies too much.
Social media should be banned for children under 16.
Politicians and experts mostly look after their own interests, not those of ordinary people.
Scientists and experts should have a big say in government decisions.
Mainstream news media generally do a good job of reporting honestly.
Citizens should be able to force a binding referendum on important issues.
Complex decisions are better left to elected representatives than to referendums.
The people, not politicians, should make the most important decisions.
Judges should be able to strike down laws that break the constitution.

local.NL: Courts should be allowed to test laws against the constitution, which they currently can't in the Netherlands.
local.UK: Courts should be able to overrule Parliament when a law breaches human rights.

items.text: Elected politicians, not judges, should have the final say on important issues.
The government should be able to ignore court rulings that go against the will of the people.
Regions and cities should get more power to make their own decisions.

local.UK: Scotland and Wales should get more self-government, up to independence if they want it.
local.US: States, not the federal government, should decide most issues.

items.text: Important decisions should be made nationally, so the same rules apply everywhere.
Local communities know better than the national government what they need.
